notes: Lighter and steadier: the pull leaderboard is cached instead of rebuilt several times a second, the log file is capped at 4 MB, and the overlay no longer crashes on monitors left of or above the main one. Also restart-safe: the Plugin Hub can now restart it every 10 minutes (change or turn off on the hub's Diagnostics page) so long sessions stay smooth, and settings and progress carry over. Settings files are now saved safely, so a crash can no longer reset them.
